project.name: Ludlow Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes:
Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 26 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 270 of 439 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

Broad visitor-attraction editorial discovery pass 2026-08-13: expanded See discovery beyond historic records using a local OSM extract. Automatically discovered additions remain below Recommended until source-backed editorial review.

touristAppeal.label: Destination draw
touristAppeal.summary: Ludlow earns destination status through a rare combination of a major medieval castle, an outstanding parish church, a coherent historic centre, independent food culture and strong walks from the town itself.

townGuide.headline: A medieval hill town built for slow wandering and serious appetites
townGuide.intro: Ludlow's castle, market streets and riverside paths form one of England's most satisfying compact town visits. Start with the fortress and St Laurence's, browse the market and independent shops, then descend to the River Teme for a different view of the old town.
perfectFor: Walkers who like history with scenery

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Castle, market and St Laurence's
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Begin at Ludlow Castle, cross Castle Square for the market, visit St Laurence's and finish with the Breadwalk or Millennium Green if time and weather allow.

townGuide.visitorMood: A richly layered historic town where the streets, food and river setting are part of the attraction.

visitorHighlights.name: Ludlow Castle
visitorHighlights.reason: Substantial medieval ruins, towers and viewpoints make this the defining Ludlow attraction and a genuine destination-scale castle visit.
visitorHighlights.admission: Adult £10; child aged 5-15 £5; family £28; under 5s free.

attractionGuide.headline: The essential Ludlow visit
attractionGuide.intro: A remarkably complete castle complex with Norman, medieval and Tudor layers, broad views and enough surviving spaces to reward an unhurried visit.
attractionGuide.foodNote: The Castle Cafe has indoor seating and a dog-friendly terrace; check current service before travelling.
attractionGuide.toilets: Visitor toilets are available within the castle complex.

thingsToDo.name: Climb the surviving towers for views across Ludlow
Trace the Norman keep and medieval inner bailey
Explore the round chapel and royal apartments
Look across the roofs to the Shropshire Hills
Pause in the courtyards and castle grounds

visitorHighlights.name: St Laurence's Church
visitorHighlights.reason: A grand medieval parish church with outstanding fittings, stained glass and monuments, right in the centre of Ludlow.

attractionGuide.headline: Ludlow's landmark church
attractionGuide.intro: Step inside for medieval misericords, stained glass, monuments and the scale of a building often described as the cathedral of the Marches.
attractionGuide.toilets: An accessible toilet is available for visitors.
attractionGuide.foodNote: Icon Coffee operates in the church during published daytime hours.

thingsToDo.name: See the medieval misericords and choir stalls
Look for the Palmers window and historic glass
Explore the monuments and local stories
Appreciate the scale of the nave and tower crossing
Pause at Icon Coffee when open

visitorHighlights.name: Ludlow Museum at the Butter Cross
visitorHighlights.reason: A compact, useful introduction to Ludlow's archaeology, geology, trades and civic history in the heart of town.
visitorHighlights.admission: Paid adult admission; under 16s free. Check the current adult price because official pages differ.

attractionGuide.headline: The town story in one compact stop
attractionGuide.intro: Use the museum to connect the castle and streets with the people, industries and landscape that shaped Ludlow.
attractionGuide.toilets: Visitor toilets are available in the museum building.

thingsToDo.name: Explore the geology of the surrounding area
Learn about local trades and civic life
See changing displays and community stories
Use the displays to orient a town-centre walk

visitorHighlights.name: The Butter Cross
visitorHighlights.reason: An elegant civic landmark and useful orientation point where Ludlow’s castle, market and historic streets come together.
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: Outdoor landmark visible at all times.

attractionGuide.headline: The crossroads of old Ludlow
attractionGuide.intro: Pause here for the architecture and orientation: the Butter Cross sits where several of the most rewarding historic streets meet.

thingsToDo.name: Look down Broad Street towards Broad Gate
Use the junction to explore the market streets
